title: Full-root coefficient change and affine profinite test coefficients
statement: Let $p$ be a prime, $J$ a finite set, $R,S$ commutative rings, $t:J\to R$, $t':J\to S$, and $f:R\to S$ a ring homomorphism with $f(t_j)=t'_j$ for every $j$. Write $A_p(R,t)$ for the full compatible parameter-root algebra [def-sfb-full-parameter-root-tower], with its specified roots $x_{j,n}$ for all positive prime-to-$p$ orders and its power transitions for divisibility. Define the coefficient-change homomorphism $A_p(R,t)\to A_p(S,t')$ by applying $f$ to every coefficient and sending every labelled root $x_{j,n}$ to the root with the same label and order. Concretely it is the quotient of the polynomial coefficient map; the compatibility hypothesis carries the root equations to the target root equations and preserves every power-transition relation. Its base-change specialization is the map $A_p(R,t)\to A_p(S,f(t))$ obtained by setting $t'=f\circ t$. For a profinite set $P$, define $R_P=R\otimes_{\mathbf Z}LC(P,\mathbf Z)$, with its canonical coefficient inclusion $R\to R_P$, $r\mapsto r\otimes1$. This is the affine coordinate-ring presentation of $U[P]$ for $U=\operatorname{Spec}R$ and the profinite test construction [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects]: the affine fibre-product formula, with tensor-factor interchange, identifies $\operatorname{Spec}R_P$ over $U$ with $\operatorname{Spec}LC(P,\mathbf Z)\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}U$, whose map to $U$ is induced by that coefficient inclusion. Thus substitution of $R_P$ and the images of $t_j$ is precisely the coefficient presentation for the profinite test object $U[P]$, rather than a different test construction. Empty $J$, empty $P$, zero rings, and order one are allowed.
